visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a mascot character, Chip, wearing a grey top hat and a blue checkered scarf. A hand enters from the right holding a light blue postcard and a yellow pen, gesturing for an autograph. The setting is an outdoor theme park with a wooden fence and greenery in the background under bright, natural daylight. (2) A wider shot reveals the 'Grizzly Gulch' area, showing the mascot characters Chip and Dale in cowboy-themed vests and hats. A man wearing black overalls, a plaid shirt, and a festive reindeer headband stands between them, smiling and holding a postcard. Other visitors and park staff are visible in the background near a wooden water tower structure. (3) A montage follows showing the man and a female companion interacting enthusiastically with the mascots. They pose for photos, hug the characters, and laugh. The camera uses handheld movements and fast cuts to capture the dynamic interactions. The man eventually holds up the signed postcard to the camera, revealing the names 'Chip' and 'Dale' written in a playful hand.
